limitations: Unchanged buildMarina101 original reproduces233064triangles/24689924bytes exactly. Continuous vertical glazing and flat mullions replace repeated window cells. Projected sill leading-edge strips and flat crown seams replace repeated beam shells; tiny podium masonry joints omitted. All24closed crown blades remain; narrow central cruciform slot stays open. District restores podium windows/seaward porch, four sampled flare piers and six-bay lift bracing intervals, four-course ribbon cadence. Street restores14flare piers, every ribbon datum, coarse window frames, wing ribs, alternate lift ties and sparse crown seams. Near restores per-bay two-tone spandrels/reveals/projected sills, fine crown seams/wing ribs/full lift ties and translucent vestibule doors.
